translated: This is... the power of the gods...
No one is permitted to touch it.

To think a mere vessel would try to gain the power of the gods...
What arrogance.

Now that's a surprise...
To hear 'arrogance' come out of your mouth.

You...
I'll teach you what a god truly is.
Hey now, am I the last one...?

We promised to go to Valhalla together...
Isn't that a bit cruel?

I'm right in front of you!
I haven't died yet.
To think that at this point Lezard would get one over on me...
He told me to lean on him, and all along his aim was Odin's spirit...
To think we'd been deceived all along...
I can't just sit here doing nothing...
We have to get at least the Dragon Orb back quickly, or it'll be too late!

Of course!
What do you think I came all this way for!?

It's to save Midgard!
At this point we've no choice but to leave Lezard be.
Let's pray he hasn't already gone to take over Valhalla!
And if we save Brahms and get him on our side, we still have a chance!

Using a thing like that won't kill you.
Your soul may be human, but your body is undead.
Right now I'm only a soul.

The deathly pain from a moment ago
vanished like it was a lie.
It's true that the body is a shackle on the soul.

Even so, at this rate,
sooner or later I'll disappear...

Just now, for a moment, I felt it...
How should I put it, it was really...
You'll be able to do it next time.
You did it <PART> ---- <PART> you really did it!

I'm inside.
Now, next, focus your mind on the ring...
Let's look for it! It should be around here...

What, if you knew, that saves time.
Let's go look right away!
Now no one can gain the power of the gods here...
Get a hold of yourself! Wake up!

It is a shame to lose such a vessel, but
I cannot overlook this sinful, insolent act against me.

The human who once hosted Silmeria...
Do you fancy yourself a god, however small?

A false undead, how utterly shameless...
Then I shall punish the both of you together.

To leave your body and sneak all the way here as a spirit...
You too have crossed a line that must not be crossed.

My transfer circle failed and I could not save you all.
For a long time I was lost and alone...
...However, whether one such as I can stand against him...
